The §6Matrix Frame§f is an internal block used by AE2's §6Spatial IO§f system. It wraps the destination region during a Spatial IO transfer and is automatically removed when the transfer completes.

It has no crafting recipe and cannot be obtained in survival. The block is §bunbreakable§f (hardness -1.0, resistance 6,000,000) and fully transparent for lighting.

If you see Matrix Frames in your world, a Spatial IO transfer is in progress. Wait for it to finish. Stuck frames usually indicate a crashed transfer.

§cWARNING:§f Do not attempt to mine Matrix Frames with a pickaxe. They will not drop and your tool will lose durability. Break the §6Spatial IO Port§f and reassemble the multiblock to fix stuck transfers.
